landmark_classification.A_Withers: (a) Hybrid: Min-Y peak within (b) 35%-60% X-window heuristic
landmark_classification.B_Hip_Hook: (a) Hybrid: Min-Y peak within (b) 62%-85% X-window heuristic
landmark_classification.C_Pin_Bone: (a) Hybrid: Max-X boundary within (b) 82%-97% X-window heuristic
landmark_classification.D_Point_Shoulder: (a) Hybrid: Min-X boundary within (b) 22%-40% X-window heuristic
landmark_classification.E1_Front_Hoof: (b) Geometric derivation: Bottom-most Y under Point A's X-coordinate
landmark_classification.E2_Rear_Hoof: (b) Geometric derivation: Bottom-most Y under Point B's X-coordinate
landmark_classification.F_Flank: (b) Pure Geometric derivation: Midpoint of (B_x + C_x)/2, y = B_y + 15% height
landmark_classification.G_Head_Eye: (b) Pure Geometric derivation: Center of head region X-span, y = ymin + 20% height

behavior_finding: FINDING: The landmarks re-anchor relative to the NEW bounding box window rather than strictly following physical rigid-body rotation. Because Points A, B, C, D search inside fixed percentage windows of the current mask's bounding box [xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax], rotating the mask changes the bounding box bounds, causing the heuristic search windows to shift. Consequently, the landmark positions re-adapt to the new silhouette bounding box contour rather than remaining fixed to physical anatomical coordinates.
